mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 5% in a given month coincides with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to higher discount rates eroding expected equity payoffs.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 5.0% in the current month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during post-tightening periods (p > 0.05), or FEDFUNDS does not exceed 5.0% in the trigger month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in UNRATE above 3.8% for two consecutive months coincides with a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as labor market tightening reduces wage growth expectations and supports equity valuations.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 3.8% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative during UNRATE expansions above 3.8%, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly surge in HOUST (household spending index) above the prior month's level, accompanied by a decline in UNRATE, predicts a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as stronger consumer demand outweighs higher borrowing costs.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > previous month AND UNRATE < previous month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite the combined signal, or the interaction coefficient is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in INDPRO (industrial production index) of at least 2% predicts a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return as weak manufacturing momentum suggests ongoing supply-side weakness.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls by ≥2% in two consecutive months
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not negative during INDPRO contractions, or the effect is absent in non-crisis regimes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 4-month decline in CPIAUCSL (CPI year-on-year) below the prior 4-month average predicts a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as deflationary expectations lower real discount rates.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL declines for 4 consecutive months below previous 4-month average
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during CPIAUCSL deflation episodes (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden one-standard-deviation increase in PAYEMS (employment months) coincides with a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as labor market expansion boosts investor confidence.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >1σ from the prior month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain flat or negative during strong labor expansions (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in RSAFS (retail sales index) above the 90th percentile of its 12-month rolling distribution predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to excessive inventory build-up and falling margins.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during high-RSAFS episodes (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in GDPC1 (GDP chained) and INDPRO for two consecutive months are associated with a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return as dual supply-demand pressures suppress growth expectations.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < previous month AND INDPRO < previous month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not negative during simultaneous GDP and production contractions (p > 0.05).
